In general, remember to use a new condom for each sexual encounter, store condoms in a cool, dry place, and check the expiration date before use. When putting on a condom, ensure it's the right way around (the rolled-up side should be outside) and leave some space at the top for semen to collect during sexual activity.

Practice using a condom by yourself or with a partner before relying on it for protection during intercourse. If you have any questions or concerns, don't hesitate to speak with a healthcare provider for advice tailored to your specific situation.
